name: coucou
description: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.

capability_evidence.auto-failover: e permission requests show up with Allow / Deny / Always; AskUserQuestion prompts show the choices right in the notch (single or multi-select, up to 4 questions).
capability_evidence.mobile-access: your macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager or Linux Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet).
capability_evidence.model-routing: p to the right terminal — open the exact terminal window of a session (macOS).
capability_evidence.security-isolation: See what Claude is editing, live in the notch: each file modification shows the file name and +N −M counts in the ticker, tap to read the full diff
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: out as a beta: download it from Coucou for Linux 0.1.1 (beta), x8664 only for now.
capability_evidence.notifications: your iPhone's Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with the agent's state, then comes back to the notch when you unlock.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot

friction.note_en: Easy. install via Homebrew install, native installer / package; needs git clone (build from source), npm install/build; configure API key configuration, database dependency; one-click setup
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 Homebrew install、native installer / package 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)、npm install/build；需配置 API key configuration、database dependency；one-click setup

analysis.summary_en: A tiny friend that lives in your Mac's notch — or at the top of your screen on Windows and Linux — and keeps an eye on your AI coding agent sessions.
highlights: 🤖 Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Copilot CLI, Muse Code, OpenCode, Amp and other agents, live — see every session in your notch: what it reads, edits and runs, step by…
📋 Declare the tools you use — open Settings → Active pills and pick your main workspace tool (VS Code, Cursor, Codex or Antigravity), then toggle up to 4 more: Gemini CLI, Anthropic, Google…
💬 Chat with Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, or a local model (Ollama / LM Studio) — click the model name above the chat box to switch provider and pick a model.
